articles.title: Crypto executives say digital native generations may never need a bank account
articles.snippet: teakhouse Financial co-founder Adrian Cachinero says digital-native generations may rely less on banks, while Binance says younger users are already driving crypto adoption in emerging markets.

articles.title: DOG Mode explains Bitcoin's next governance fight
articles.snippet: Leonidas' DOG Mode client challenges Bitcoin's default relay policies, reopening a philosophical debate over censorship, free markets and who really governs the network.

articles.title: Trump targets Brazil's payments system while dollar stablecoins are quietly overtaking country's payments
articles.snippet: Washington views Brazil’s promotion of non-dollar payment channels, including Pix and the growth of stablecoins, as a potential threat to dollar-based trade, even as dollar-linked stablecoins account for about 90% of Brazil's crypto transactions.

articles.title: Here is why a massive $1.6 billion in crypto liquidity is sitting idle and wasting away
articles.snippet: About $542 million weekly sat outside active trading ranges, meaning this capital earned zero fees and provided no market depth.

articles.title: Massive bitcoin call spreads target $72,000 by month end, right when the Fed meets
articles.snippet: Large traders are betting on a BTC price rise to $72,000 by the end of the month, latest options market flow suggests.
